events.title: 블랙번 로버스 go top of the Premier League, displacing 노리치 시티 in dramatic fashion with a 7–1 win at Ewood Park. Strikers Alan Shearer and Roy Wegerle both find the net twice. Coventry hold onto third place with a 2–2 home draw against 크리스털 팰리스. Defending champions Leeds crash to a 4–2 defeat at 입스위치 타운. QPR are fourth after a 4–1 home win over their London rivals 토트넘 홋스퍼, who are on the brink of the relegation zone.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 extend their 100% start to the Division One season to nine games with a 2–1 win over 브렌트퍼드 at Griffin Park . 울버햄프턴 원더러스 miss out on the chance to go second when 웨스트햄 유나이티드 hold them to a goalless draw at home.

리즈 유나이티드 defeat VfB 슈투트가르트 2–0 in a play-off in the first round of the 1992–93 UEFA Champions League in the Nou Camp . Based on the results in the first two matches, Leeds would have been eliminated on the away goals rule . However, near the end of the second leg at Elland Road, 슈투트가르트 had fielded four foreign players rather than the maximum permitted three. The result was declared void and Leeds were awarded the match 3–0 meaning a play-off was needed, which was staged in 바르셀로나 .

The following week's international fixtures mean that there is no Premier League action this weekend. However, Football League fixtures are played, with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 now having won 10 successive fixtures, beating Tranmere 1–0 at home. Second-placed Charlton lose 2–1 to 브리스틀 시티 at Ashton Gate, but 울버햄프턴 원더러스 miss another chance to leapfrog them when they are held to a 1–1 draw by Southend at Roots Hall . 왓퍼드 climb into the top half of the table with a 4–2 home win over 브리스틀 로버스, who fall into bottom place.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 boost their Division One promotion push with another big victory, this time defeating 선덜랜드 6–0 at Upton Park.

마르코 판바스턴 makes his last appearance for the Dutch national team , earning his 58th cap against Poland. Gerald Vanenburg (42nd) and Berry van Aerle (35th) also play their last match for the Dutch, while Arthur Numan makes his debut in the World Cup qualifier in De Kuip , Rotterdam .
England draw 1–1 with Norway in their disappointing opener to the World Cup qualifying series.
토트넘 홋스퍼 striker Gordon Durie is banned for three games after feigning an injury in order to win his team a free kick.

노리치 시티 go back on top of the Premier League with a 2–1 home win over QPR, although victory for 블랙번 로버스 on Monday will send 케니 달글리시 's team back to the summit of the league. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 move into second place in Division with a 4–0 away win of 브리스틀 로버스. Fifth-placed Swindon beat 노츠 카운티 5–1 at home.

카디프 시티 chairman Rick Wright announces he is considering withdrawing the club from the Football League in order to transfer to the League of Wales next season. Ian Rush breaks Roger Hunt 's 23-year goalscoring for 리버풀, and scores his 287th goal for the club in their 2–2 league draw with 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford, although the Reds surrender their 2–0 lead when Mark Hughes scores twice during the final 10 minutes. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 make it 11 successive victories with a 2–1 win over local rivals 선덜랜드 at Roker Park, and are now 10 points ahead of second-placed 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 11 points ahead of third-placed 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
블랙번 로버스 miss the chance to regain their lead of the Premier League when they are held to a goalless draw at 애스턴 빌라.
체스터 시티 part company with manager Harry McNally after seven years in charge, following a poor start to the season.
노팅엄 포리스트 are still bottom of the Premier League despite recording their second win of the season, a 1–0 home victory over 미들즈브러.
케임브리지 유나이티드 sack John Beck , who had guided them to successive promotions in the first two of his three seasons as manager.

Barclays Bank announce that they will not be renewing their sponsorship of the Football League after the end of the season. Barclays have been the league's sponsors since the start of the 1987–88 season.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드's 11-match winning start to the Division One campaign ends with a 1–0 defeat at home to 그림즈비 타운. 블랙번 로버스 go top of the Premier League on goal difference with a goalless draw at home to 맨체스터 유나이티드, who have now gone 10 league games without a defeat but have drawn their last five following a five-match winning run, pushing them down to seventh place. The recent shortage of goals has led to calls for 알렉스 퍼거슨 to sign another striker, and a recent £3.5million bid for 셰필드 웬즈데이 striker David Hirst has been rejected.
노리치 시티 miss the chance to go back on top of the Premier League with a 4–1 defeat to 리버풀 at Anfield .
Former 퀸스 파크 레인저스 captain Glenn Roeder is appointed player-manager of 질링엄 in place of Damien Richardson .

October ends with 블랙번 로버스 ahead of 노리치 시티 at the top of the Premier League with a vastly superior goal difference, after both teams were held to draws today. QPR, 아스널 and Coventry are all three points behind them, with QPR and 아스널 both having a game in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer their first defeat in 11 games when a Lawrie Sanchez goal gives 윔블던 a 1–0 at Old Trafford and lifts the visitors out of the relegation zone. 에버턴 have now fallen into the relegation zone after some promising performances early in the season, having lost 3–1 at home to 맨체스터 시티 today.
